name: IndexedDB ignores the shared last-write time
why: _rgIdbGet() is the one IndexedDB read of the popup engine's MusicBrainz records. Without the C7 check, a card fetched before another script's write is served from IndexedDB for the whole sa_pop_mb_ttl_hours.

edits.find: Date.now() - rec.at < ttlMs && !_mbKeptStale(key, rec.at) ? { data: rec.data, at: rec.at } : null;
edits.replace: Date.now() - rec.at < ttlMs ? { data: rec.data, at: rec.at } : null;

grep: a card kept in IndexedDB: a write before it keeps it, a write after it drops it

name: a card in memory ignores the shared last-write time
why: _mbLoad()'s memory: a card loaded earlier in this tab short-circuits the load, so a write made since (in Event Horizon's view, or another tab) never shows.
grep: a card kept in memory is reused, until another script reports a write

name: a release group's releases in memory ignore the shared last-write time
why: _rgReleasesLoad(): without the stale flag the memory short-circuit and the prev carry-over keep the old releases after a write.
grep: a release group: its releases and its facts are asked again after a write

name: a release group's facts in memory ignore the shared last-write time
why: _rgFactsLoad(): the facts carry the ratings and genres Event Horizon's writes change; from memory they stay old.
grep: a release group: its releases and its facts are asked again after a write

name: a paged list in memory ignores the shared last-write time
why: _mbPagedStart(): loaded rows short-circuit the start, so a list window (a work's recordings, a collection, an edit list) keeps the rows of before the write.
grep: its loaded recordings are reused, until another script reports a write

name: every key counts as a MusicBrainz record
why: The prefix list keeps the external readers (ext:, ext-...:) and the Wikidata picture (pop:img:) out: no MusicBrainz write changes them. Matching every key would re-ask Wikipedia, Discogs, setlist.fm after each rating.
grep: which keys a write makes stale

name: a card's Wikidata picture counts as a MusicBrainz record
why: pop:img: holds what Wikidata/Commons answered, which a MusicBrainz write does not change; the negative lookahead keeps it out of pop:.
grep: which keys a write makes stale

name: the comparison runs the wrong way
why: An answer is kept only when fetched strictly AFTER the last write (Event Horizon's rule). Reversed, a write before the fetch drops it and a write after keeps it.
grep: a card kept in IndexedDB: a write before it keeps it, a write after it drops it

name: an answer fetched at the very time of the write is kept
why: Kept only when fetched strictly after the write: at === lastWrite counts as stale, as Event Horizon's e.at > mbLastWrite().
grep: which keys a write makes stale

name: no script has written, yet everything is stale
why: With the key absent (0) nothing may be stale, or every card would be asked again on every hover.
grep: which keys a write makes stale
